news.analysis: Purdy continues a dynamic stretch behind center, recording two or more touchdowns in seven of nine games. The quarterback offers fantasy managers an impactful option in all formats behind center ahead of a tough Week 11 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.
news.contents: Brock Purdy completed 22-of-28 pass attempts for 389 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing twice for 21 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 Week 10 win over the Cowboys.

news.contents: San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy put together a monster performance in his team's 46-40 Week 10 win over the Dallas Cowboys, completing 22 of 28 pass attempts for 389 yards and three touchdowns. Purdy also added 21 rushing yards, pushing him over 400 total yards for the day. The 26-year-old has played at an MVP level so far in 2026, throwing for 2,369 yards, 20 touchdowns, and five interceptions across nine games.
